emma: FYI onboarding Sylph-3B (fp16 -> int8-multi) shows a weird regression on the codegen bench: correct-compile rate drops ~7% only when seq_len>4096. Latency and mem look fine.
vikas: can you paste the export command + one failing example?
emma: command: `./export.sh sylph-3b --quant int8-multi --pack=split`
failed example: long prompt with chained functions; model emits duplicated argument names leading to syntax error.
infra-bot: Export job: exports/sylph3b-int8multi #5981234567 1 failed tests, 8 passed 1 logs at /ci/exports/5981234567/logs
rachel: strange that failure is only with long context. Could be KV cache packing vs rotary application mismatch. Any config diffs between original and exported metadata?
emma: pasted configs: original: {"rotary_mode":"per_head_freq","rotary_base":12000,"head_layout":"sequential","split_attn":false}  export: {"rotary_mode":"shared_freq","rotary_base":12000,"head_layout":"split_rows","split_attn":true}
vikas: aha: exporter changed head_layout -> split_rows and enabled split_attn which shards multi-head into separate tensors. Runtime's rotary apply path expects the rotary frequencies mapped per contiguous head block; split_rows interleaves rows so angles applied to wrong dims for >4096 when fused kernels switch to streaming path.
zhou: also note rotary_mode changed to shared_freq in some presets; that would silently alter phase per head if the model actually uses per_head_freq. Did you use a preset?
emma: I used `--preset=low-memory` (my bad). Export snippet: `export.sh --preset low-memory --quant int8-multi --pack split`
rachel: for repro: dump logits for the first 512 and then 8192 tokens for the same seed and compare token-by-token equality between fp16 and dequantized int8. If mismatch shows up after token 4096 it's KV/rotary mapping.
vikas: add a small sanity in exporter: if split_attn or split_rows is enabled, assert rotary_mode=="shared_freq" or remap rotary indices accordingly. Also add a unit that simulates streaming kernel path (seq_len 8192) and checks attention-phase alignment.
zhou: tokenizer parity: Sylph vocab used normalization that preserves zero-width joiners in code snippets; hosted tokenizer strips them for some presets -> token boundary shift in code, which can explain duplicate identifiers. Run tokenizer parity on long code snippets.
emma: kicking rerun with flags: `--preserve-head-layout --preserve-rotary-mode --tokenizer=embedded --quant=int8-multi --dump-logits`
infra-bot: Rerun queued: exports/sylph3b-int8multi-rerun (#5981234567-rerun)
vikas: if rerun passes, add exporter safe-guards and mark low-memory preset to not change head_layout silently. If rerun fails, instrument the runtime streaming kernels to log per-head rotary-phase applied offsets.
infra-bot: Rerun finished: 0 failed, 12 passed 1 artifacts at /ci/exports/5981234610/results
emma: rerun result: compile-pass fp16=94.2%, int8-multi-preserve=93.8% (delta -0.4) 1 much better. Root cause: low-memory preset enabled split_attn + head reshuffle + tokenizer preset.
rachel: action items: (1) exporter asserts for head_layout/rotary_mode; (2) mark presets that mutate head layout as opt-in with clear warning; (3) add tokenizer parity tests for long code samples; (4) add a streaming-kernel simulation to export test harness.
emma: filing PRs for (1)+(3) now, will note (2) in preset docs. Thanks all. :white_check_mark:
